packageRules.description: Track plugin-barman-cloud chart and flag the TLS cert workaround
prBodyNotes: :warning: This repo carries a workaround for cloudnative-pg/charts#781 (broken chart TLS certs on cert-manager >= 1.18): `certificate.createServerCertificate`/`createClientCertificate` are set to `false` in the HelmRelease and the server/client certs are self-managed in `apps/cnpg/barman/certificates/` (reconciled by the `cnpg-barman-certs` Kustomization).

Before merging, check whether this release fixes #781 or wires `certificate.issuerName` (PR #811). If so, you can point `issuerName` at `barman-cloud-ca-issuer` (or re-enable the chart certs) and remove the `certificates/` directory and the `cnpg-barman-certs` Kustomization.

packageRules.description: Substrate stack must upgrade in lockstep; never automerge. substrate chart + substrate-crds + substrate-podcert + kagent + kagent-crds + ateom-gvisor worker image + golang-adk workload image move as one group because kagent vendors a specific kagent-dev/substrate (check go/go.mod replace at the kagent tag before merging). Paired at 1.0.0-alpha11 + 0.5.0-alpha2 (alpha11 vendors substrate v0.5.0-alpha2).
prBodyNotes: :warning: Lockstep group. Before merging: (1) read go/go.mod at the new kagent tag and confirm the replace github.com/agent-substrate/substrate => github.com/kagent-dev/substrate <version> matches the substrate chart version in this PR; if it does not, do NOT merge and re-pin. (2) Bump the Harness workload.image digest (kagent/app/harnesses.yaml) and controller.sandbox.guestImage.digest (kagent HelmRelease values) to the same kagent tag. (3) The gcr.io/gke-release/pause digest in the substrate HelmRelease SandboxConfig postRenderer is intentionally static (separate exclusion rule).

packageRules.description: Do NOT track gcr.io/gke-release/pause. It is digest-pinned in the substrate HelmRelease's SandboxConfig postRenderer (apps/ai-system/substrate/app/helmrelease.yaml): changing the image invalidates actor snapshots, so the pin must stay put. Renovate tracks it by digest, but the upstream `latest`/`go` tags point at a deprecated 2014 pause 1.0 image (single-arch amd64), so digest tracking keeps proposing an 11-year downgrade to that image (PR #559; an earlier identical bump was merged as 083842da and reverted as 89f9a725). Keep the pin manual: exclude it from all updates. When the substrate stack is upgraded to a new pause, bump the digest by hand in the same PR.

Track floating tags by digest. Tags like latest/edge/main are not versions, so Renovate skips them as invalid-value; pinning the digest lets it raise update PRs when the tag is rebuilt. (nsyncd is also semver-tracked; the digest pin just adds rebuild-level updates.)
Group CNPG operand + extension catalog images so the catalog updates as one set
Auto-merge patch updates for media apps
